summary: Wavetable synth: two table oscillators with warps, sub and noise, a filter, three envelopes, two LFOs and a mod matrix; loads WAV wavetables. Use it for evolving pads, digital leads and modern basses.
use_for: Wavetable pads, sweeps, wobble basses and vowel-like leads from two warped table oscillators.

parameters.name: Voice mode
parameters.description: Poly; Mono retriggers; Legato glides without retriggering
parameters.how: Chooses how notes share voices: Poly plays chords, Mono retriggers on each note, Legato glides between overlapping notes.
parameters.sound: Poly suits pads and chords, Mono gives a punchy lead or bass line, and Legato gives smooth, connected phrases.

parameters.name: Polyphony
parameters.how: Sets how many notes can sound at once, from 1 to 16.
parameters.sound: More voices let chords and long releases overlap, while fewer save processing power and make notes cut each other off.

parameters.name: Unison
parameters.how: Sets the number of stacked voices per note, from 1 to 8.
parameters.sound: More voices make the note thicker and wider, and one voice is a single clean oscillator.

parameters.name: Uni detune
parameters.description: Detune between unison voices (up to ±50 cents)
parameters.how: Sets how far apart the unison voices are tuned, up to 50 cents.
parameters.sound: Small amounts give a warm thickness and large ones a wide, swarming supersaw sound.

parameters.name: Uni spread
parameters.how: Sets how widely the unison voices are spread across the stereo field, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: More spread makes the note wider and more enveloping, and zero keeps it centred.

parameters.name: Glide mode
parameters.how: Chooses when notes slide into each other: never, always, or only on overlapping notes.
parameters.sound: Gliding adds a singing, synth-bass slur between notes.

parameters.name: Glide
parameters.how: Sets how long the slide takes, up to 2 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short glides are subtle and long ones sweep slowly between pitches.

parameters.name: Bend range
parameters.how: Sets how far the pitch bend wheel moves the pitch, from 0 to 24 semitones.
parameters.sound: A small range gives expressive nudges, and a large one gives dive-bomb sweeps.

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.how: Sets the output level of the synth, from -40 to +6 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: Use it to place the instrument in the mix without changing its tone.

parameters.name: Vel → amp
parameters.how: Sets how strongly note velocity changes the loudness, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: High values make playing dynamics audible, and 0 % makes all notes equally loud.

parameters.name: A table
parameters.description: Wavetable (User: the table loaded in the editor)
parameters.how: Chooses the wavetable for oscillator A, from the built-in sets or the loaded User table.
parameters.sound: Each table has its own family of tones, from basic shapes to vowels, sweeping sync and gritty digital sounds.

parameters.name: A position
parameters.description: Position in the table (frames morph smoothly)
parameters.how: Moves through the frames of oscillator A's wavetable, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Moving the position morphs the tone smoothly from one timbre to the next, and modulating it makes evolving sounds.

parameters.name: A warp
parameters.how: Chooses how the cycle of oscillator A is bent or read: bend, squeeze, mirror, asymmetry, window sync or phase modulation.
parameters.sound: Each warp reshapes the waveform and adds harmonics, from subtle fattening to hard, metallic edges.

parameters.name: A warp amt
parameters.how: Sets how strongly the warp is applied to oscillator A, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Zero leaves the table untouched, and more warp makes the tone progressively more extreme.

parameters.name: A octave
parameters.how: Transposes oscillator A up or down by up to three octaves.
parameters.sound: Lower octaves give weight and higher ones brightness or a thin layer.

parameters.name: A semi
parameters.how: Transposes oscillator A by up to 12 semitones either way.
parameters.sound: Use it to build intervals and chords from the two oscillators, such as a fifth.

parameters.name: A fine
parameters.how: Detunes oscillator A by up to 50 cents either way.
parameters.sound: A few cents between the oscillators gives a slow, warm beating.

parameters.name: A level
parameters.how: Sets the level of oscillator A into the filter, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Use it to balance the two oscillators against each other.

parameters.name: B table
parameters.description: Wavetable (User: the table loaded in the editor)
parameters.how: Chooses the wavetable for oscillator B, from the built-in sets or the loaded User table.
parameters.sound: Each table has its own family of tones, from basic shapes to vowels, sweeping sync and gritty digital sounds.

parameters.name: B position
parameters.description: Position in the table (frames morph smoothly)
parameters.how: Moves through the frames of oscillator B's wavetable, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Moving the position morphs the tone smoothly from one timbre to the next, and modulating it makes evolving sounds.

parameters.name: B warp
parameters.description: How the cycle is read (PM from B acts on osc A only; here it reads plainly)
parameters.how: Chooses how the cycle of oscillator B is bent or read: bend, squeeze, mirror, asymmetry, window sync or phase modulation.
parameters.sound: Each warp reshapes the waveform and adds harmonics, from subtle fattening to hard, metallic edges.

parameters.name: B warp amt
parameters.how: Sets how strongly the warp is applied to oscillator B, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Zero leaves the table untouched, and more warp makes the tone progressively more extreme.

parameters.name: B octave
parameters.how: Transposes oscillator B up or down by up to three octaves.
parameters.sound: Lower octaves give weight and higher ones brightness or a thin layer.

parameters.name: B semi
parameters.how: Transposes oscillator B by up to 12 semitones either way.
parameters.sound: Use it to build intervals and chords from the two oscillators, such as a fifth.

parameters.name: B fine
parameters.how: Detunes oscillator B by up to 50 cents either way.
parameters.sound: A few cents between the oscillators gives a slow, warm beating.

parameters.name: B level
parameters.how: Sets the level of oscillator B into the filter, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Use it to balance the two oscillators against each other.

parameters.name: Sub shape
parameters.how: Chooses a sine or a square wave for the sub oscillator.
parameters.sound: Sine gives a smooth, deep foundation and square a more audible, buzzy bass.

parameters.name: Sub octave
parameters.how: Chooses whether the sub oscillator sits one or two octaves below the note.
parameters.sound: One octave down adds weight and two octaves down adds a rumble.

parameters.name: Sub level
parameters.description: Sets the level of the sub oscillator, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.how: Sets the level of the sub oscillator, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Raise it for more low-end weight in bass and lead sounds.

parameters.name: Noise
parameters.how: Sets the level of the noise source, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: A little adds air and breath, and a lot makes the sound hissy and percussive.

parameters.name: Filter type
parameters.how: Chooses the filter model: 24 or 12 dB ladder, state-variable low-pass, band-pass, high-pass or notch, or off.
parameters.sound: The ladder is warm and smooth, the state-variable types are cleaner and more flexible, and Off leaves the oscillators open.

parameters.name: Cutoff
parameters.description: Sets the filter cutoff frequency, from 20 Hz to 20 kHz.
parameters.how: Sets the filter cutoff frequency, from 20 Hz to 20 kHz.
parameters.sound: Low values make the sound dark and muffled, and high values open it up and brighten it.

parameters.name: Reso
parameters.how: Sets the filter resonance, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: More resonance puts a whistling peak at the cutoff, and a lot makes it ring.

parameters.name: Drive
parameters.how: Pushes the signal into the filter by up to 24 dB.
parameters.sound: A little adds warmth and a lot makes the sound thick and distorted.

parameters.name: Filter env
parameters.how: Sets how much the filter envelope moves the cutoff, up to six octaves either way.
parameters.sound: Positive amounts make each note open and close, and negative ones sweep the other way.

parameters.name: Key track
parameters.how: Sets how much the cutoff follows the note pitch, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: At 100 % the brightness stays the same over the keyboard, and lower values make high notes duller.

parameters.name: Filter vel
parameters.description: Softer notes close the filter (up to 3 octaves)
parameters.how: Sets how much soft notes close the filter, up to three octaves.
parameters.sound: Harder playing sounds brighter, which makes the instrument feel more expressive.

parameters.name: Amp attack
parameters.how: Sets how long the amp envelope takes to rise from nothing to full, from 0.5 ms to 20 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short attacks hit instantly for plucks and basses, and long ones fade in slowly like a pad.

parameters.name: Amp decay
parameters.how: Sets how long the amp envelope takes to fall to its sustain level, from 0.5 ms to 20 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short decays give a plucky, percussive note, and long ones let the note ring down slowly.

parameters.name: Amp sustain
parameters.how: Sets the level the amp envelope holds while the key stays down, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: A low sustain makes the note die away even when held, and a high one keeps it at full volume.

parameters.name: Amp release
parameters.how: Sets how long the amp envelope takes to fall back after the key is released, from 0.5 ms to 20 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short releases stop the note cleanly, and long ones let it fade out after you let go.

parameters.name: Flt attack
parameters.how: Sets how long the filter envelope takes to rise from nothing to full, from 0.5 ms to 20 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short attacks open at once, and long ones make the effect swell in after the note starts.

parameters.name: Flt decay
parameters.how: Sets how long the filter envelope takes to fall to its sustain level, from 0.5 ms to 20 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short decays make a quick snap in the effect, and long ones a slow, gradual sweep down.

parameters.name: Flt sustain
parameters.how: Sets the level the filter envelope holds while the key stays down, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: A high sustain keeps the effect on while the key is held, and a low one lets it fade back.

parameters.name: Flt release
parameters.how: Sets how long the filter envelope takes to fall back after the key is released, from 0.5 ms to 20 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short releases end the effect at once, and long ones let it tail off after the note.

parameters.name: Mod attack
parameters.how: Sets how long the mod envelope takes to rise from nothing to full, from 0.5 ms to 20 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short attacks open at once, and long ones make the effect swell in after the note starts.

parameters.name: Mod decay
parameters.how: Sets how long the mod envelope takes to fall to its sustain level, from 0.5 ms to 20 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short decays make a quick snap in the effect, and long ones a slow, gradual sweep down.

parameters.name: Mod sustain
parameters.how: Sets the level the mod envelope holds while the key stays down, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: A high sustain keeps the effect on while the key is held, and a low one lets it fade back.

parameters.name: Mod release
parameters.how: Sets how long the mod envelope takes to fall back after the key is released, from 0.5 ms to 20 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short releases end the effect at once, and long ones let it tail off after the note.

parameters.name: LFO1 shape
parameters.how: Chooses the waveform of LFO 1: sine, triangle, rising or falling saw, square, random steps or smooth random.
parameters.sound: Smooth shapes give gentle sweeps, square gives on-off jumps, and random shapes give unpredictable movement.

parameters.name: LFO1 rate
parameters.how: Sets the speed of LFO 1 from 0.02 to 50 Hz when its sync is Free.
parameters.sound: Slow rates drift over seconds, and fast rates turn into vibrato and tremolo.

parameters.name: LFO1 sync
parameters.how: Locks LFO 1 to a note length of the song tempo instead of the Rate control.
parameters.sound: Synced modulation moves in time with the track.

parameters.name: LFO1 retrig
parameters.description: Restart with each note (per voice); off: one free LFO
parameters.how: Chooses whether LFO 1 restarts with each note or runs freely.
parameters.sound: Restarting gives every note the same movement, and free running makes each note slightly different.

parameters.name: LFO1 fade
parameters.description: Fade-in time after the note starts
parameters.how: Sets how long LFO 1 takes to fade in after a note starts, up to 5 seconds.
parameters.sound: A fade delays vibrato or sweeps until the note has settled, as a player would add vibrato late.

parameters.name: LFO2 shape
parameters.how: Chooses the waveform of LFO 2: sine, triangle, rising or falling saw, square, random steps or smooth random.
parameters.sound: Smooth shapes give gentle sweeps, square gives on-off jumps, and random shapes give unpredictable movement.

parameters.name: LFO2 rate
parameters.how: Sets the speed of LFO 2 from 0.02 to 50 Hz when its sync is Free.
parameters.sound: Slow rates drift over seconds, and fast rates turn into vibrato and tremolo.

parameters.name: LFO2 sync
parameters.how: Locks LFO 2 to a note length of the song tempo instead of the Rate control.
parameters.sound: Synced modulation moves in time with the track.

parameters.name: LFO2 retrig
parameters.description: Restart with each note (per voice); off: one free LFO
parameters.how: Chooses whether LFO 2 restarts with each note or runs freely.
parameters.sound: Restarting gives every note the same movement, and free running makes each note slightly different.

parameters.name: LFO2 fade
parameters.description: Fade-in time after the note starts
parameters.how: Sets how long LFO 2 takes to fade in after a note starts, up to 5 seconds.
parameters.sound: A fade delays vibrato or sweeps until the note has settled, as a player would add vibrato late.

parameters.name: M1 source
parameters.how: Chooses what drives matrix slot 1, such as an LFO, an envelope, velocity or the mod wheel.
parameters.sound: The source decides how the destination moves: steadily, with the note, or with your playing.

parameters.name: M1 dest
parameters.how: Chooses which control matrix slot 1 moves.
parameters.sound: Pointing a source at pitch, filter, level or pan changes what the movement does to the sound.

parameters.name: M1 amount
parameters.how: Sets how strongly slot 1 moves its destination, from minus 100 % to plus 100 %.
parameters.sound: Positive values push the destination up, negative values push it down, and zero does nothing.

imports.description: A WAV wavetable: frames of 2048 samples (or a clm chunk saying the frame size), or one short single cycle. Becomes the "User" table (A table or B table = User).
